independence_evidence: Site footer: '© CAP Creative S.r.l.' with Milan and Paris addresses; the publisher is a small Milan creative studio/agency that also makes the magazine Les Hommes Publics, not a media group. The magazine runs brand collaborations and advertising but is not a customer magazine.
qualifies_reason: Independent Milan publisher with print issue #22 (Summer/Fall 2026) on sale at stockists and a biannual rhythm.
what_it_is: CAP 74024 is a thick biannual Milan magazine about eros, art and fashion, built from long photographic stories, celebrity and designer interviews and luxury-brand editorials on mixed paper stocks. Issues run to around 450 pages at 28.4 x 22.5 cm with special finishes such as holographic foil and, in #22, sticker inserts. It is aimed at fashion and image professionals and collectors of large glossy independents.
